experiences.title: Dividend Dash
experiences.subject: Mathematics
experiences.learningObjective: Use the divide, multiply, subtract and bring-down sequence to construct long division accurately.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners steer through number-gates that become the quotient, product, remainder and next working number in the visible division tableau.
experiences.evidence: First-attempt accuracy by operation, completed tableau, repair steps and final quotient.
experiences.note: Gated workflow proof passed automated browser and iPad-geometry QA. Remains unpublished pending Mr Jo approval and a physical Safari/iPad touch pass.

experiences.title: JoGo Money Builder
experiences.subject: Mathematics
experiences.learningObjective: Build, compare and exchange South African money amounts, then calculate change.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners place real-value coins and notes, find equivalent combinations and build exact change.
experiences.evidence: Completed amounts, comparison choices, exchanges and change calculations.
experiences.note: Live classroom build. Device-local settings and last score.

experiences.title: JoGo Metric Master
experiences.subject: Mathematics
experiences.learningObjective: Convert length, mass and volume units and read common measuring instruments.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners predict direction, move the decimal comma and read rulers, scales and jugs.
experiences.evidence: Conversion accuracy, scale readings, retries and per-learner progress.
experiences.note: Live GitHub Pages build with learner profiles and teacher tools.

experiences.title: Tick Tock
experiences.subject: Mathematics
experiences.learningObjective: Read analogue clocks from whole and half hours through to one-minute intervals.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners read the clock face, enter the time and correct the same clock after teaching feedback.
experiences.evidence: First-attempt accuracy, corrected readings and level progress.
experiences.note: Live companion build inside the Metric Master repository.

experiences.title: JoGo Turbo Tables
experiences.subject: Mathematics
experiences.learningObjective: Recall multiplication facts from 1 × 1 to 12 × 12 accurately.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners steer towards a product, pause when needed and commit when ready.
experiences.evidence: Fact choices, accuracy and response under adjustable pace.
experiences.note: Live original build. Newer V4 and V5 builds remain in review.

experiences.title: STOMPI Meester
experiences.subject: Afrikaans FAL
experiences.learningObjective: Build Afrikaans sentences using the STOMPI word-order system.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners place sentence parts into STOMPI positions and revise the order after feedback.
experiences.evidence: Sentence construction, category placement and corrected word order.
experiences.note: Live original build. STOMPI-Speel v2 remains local.

experiences.title: Grade 4 Division
experiences.subject: Mathematics
experiences.learningObjective: Understand long division before moving to short division.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners work through each division stage in order and see how one state creates the next.
experiences.evidence: Completed method steps, quotients and remainders.

experiences.title: Turbo Tables V4: Rally Recall
experiences.subject: Mathematics
experiences.learningObjective: Build multiplication recall with mistake repair and delayed re-testing.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners choose products, use a strategy pit stop and meet missed facts again.
experiences.evidence: Accuracy, repaired facts and later overtake results.
experiences.note: Private repository. Pages URL is not live.

experiences.title: Turbo Tables V5: Golden Rally
experiences.subject: Mathematics
experiences.learningObjective: Retrieve the six-times table accurately through a paced 20-gate rally.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners steer through product lanes, recover after mistakes and repeat missed facts.
experiences.evidence: Accuracy, streak, missed-fact repair and final summary.
experiences.note: Strong technical build. Learning-system redesign recommended before public replacement.

experiences.title: JoGo Word Serpent
experiences.subject: English
experiences.learningObjective: Recognise and retrieve synonym and antonym relationships.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners steer to collect a word, then hunt for its matching relationship while staying alive.
experiences.evidence: Completed pairs, incorrect pair choices, survival and increasing pace.
experiences.note: Polished local/Sites build. Public URL still needs to be recorded.

experiences.title: JoGo WordBridge
experiences.subject: English
experiences.learningObjective: Build vocabulary recognition, meaning, use in context and spelling.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners match definitions, choose words in context and build spellings from tiles.
experiences.evidence: Mode-level accuracy, weak-word review and readiness indicators.
experiences.note: Adaptive review is strong. Core activity needs a closer knowledge-to-action connection.

experiences.title: STOMPI-Speel v2
experiences.subject: Afrikaans FAL
experiences.learningObjective: Construct Afrikaans sentences using STOMPI placement rules.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners drag word blocks into functional sentence positions and retry marked placements.
experiences.evidence: Correct word and category placement across full sentences.
experiences.note: Local iteration. Not present at the current public subpath.

experiences.title: Vertical Voyage
experiences.subject: Mathematics
experiences.learningObjective: Understand carrying and regrouping in four-digit vertical calculations.
experiences.learnerAction: Learners step through each column and see how values carry or regroup.
experiences.evidence: Completed calculation stages and final answers.
experiences.note: Local classroom teaching tool. No public deployment recorded.
